Air enters a frictionless converging nozzle at Mach 2.0.
The area ratio is A2/A1 = 0.7.
Use the quasi-one-dimensional isentropic area–Mach relation for the supersonic branch to find the exit Mach number.
Assume stagnation temperature is constant.
Compute the exit-to-inlet velocity ratio using V proportional to M divided by the square root of 1 plus 0.2 M squared.
Determine the percentage change in exit velocity as (V2 - V1)/V1 multiplied by 100.
The result is -16.1 percent, meaning the exit velocity decreases by about 16.1 percent relative to the inlet velocity.
